noDefinition: You cannot see how this lookup is set up: it uses a table or field you cannot read. You can still rename it or change its description.

shortcut.label: Shortcut: through a link field
shortcut.hint: Takes the records linked to each record of {{table}}; the first condition is made for you.
shortcut.generated: The first condition is made for you.

conditions.label: Conditions
conditions.hint: One level, up to 5 conditions, at least 1.
conditions.chooseRef: Choose a field of this table…
conditions.autoHint: “This record” is the {{table}} record being computed.
conditions.incomplete: Choose a value for this condition.
conditions.atLeastOne: Add at least one condition: a lookup never takes the whole table.
conditions.noFields: No field of this table can be used in a condition.
conditions.countLabel: {{count, number}} of at most {{max, number}} conditions
conditions.advanced: These conditions were made through the API and cannot be edited here. They stay as they are unless you replace them.
conditions.recordHint: “{{field}}” is one of the records this record links to.

format.label: Format
format.lockedHint: Values keep the format of {{field}} in {{table}}. To change it, edit the source field.

preview.title: Preview of the first 5 records
preview.idle: Choose the source table, the field to get and at least one condition to see a preview.
preview.invalid: This setup cannot be computed yet: see the messages on the left.
preview.empty: You cannot read any record of this table yet.

mode.stored: Values are stored and computed again when the source changes.
mode.virtual: Values are computed each time they are read (not stored).

preview.perfWarning: Every read of this field scans the source table: it may be slow on large tables.
preview.lockedTitle: People who cannot read the {{table}} table see an empty cell with a lock.
preview.lockedHint: Nothing of the source table is revealed.

cycle.title: This lookup would depend on itself through other fields:
cycle.hint: Choose another field or change one of the fields of the cycle.

footer.background_one: Once saved, the column is computed for {{count, number}} record in the background.
footer.background_other: Once saved, the column is computed for {{count, number}} records in the background.
footer.virtual: Values are computed when read, nothing to wait for.
